Create ONE magnificent GOLDEN CRYSTAL, the fused evolution of four gemstones: sapphire blue, ruby red, ivory white and obsidian black. A single cohesive powerful gemstone, NOT four loose crystals or a pile. Main silhouette a broad regal hexagonal prism with sharp upper and lower points, golden yellow and deep amber large angular facets, brilliant pale gold central diamond face suggesting a concentrated last light. Incorporate four SMALL integrated colored facets around the golden core: sapphire blue upper-left, ruby red upper-right, ivory white lower-left, obsidian charcoal lower-right. Gold must dominate about 80% of visible stone, four colors are restrained traces of fused ingredients. More precious and commanding than plain single-color crystals through facet architecture and strong contrast, no jewelry metal frame, crown, pedestal, symbols or text. Match existing game art: low-poly geometric flat shading, crisp large polygon planes, sober medieval style, clean readable silhouette at tiny inventory scale. Slight faceted depth, no photoreal textures or glossy 3D rendering. Full single gemstone visible centered with 8% margin. TRUE fully transparent background. No ambient halo, floating particles, extra objects, ground shadow, character, grid, card or border.
